data.name: Ramsevak
data.gender_notes: Ramsevak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who serves Rama, an incarnation of God Vishnu. The name Ramsevak carries the meaning “Servant of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramsevak usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who devote their lives to serving God and spreading love and kindness to others
data.etymology: Ramsevak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramsevak total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
